title: reader CredentialStore::from_credentials silently accepts plaintext
description: stoa-reader has its own CredentialStore in crates/reader/src/store/credentials.rs. Its from_credentials() has no bcrypt format guard. An operator config with plaintext passwords passes without panic and bcrypt::verify returns false for all logins — authentication silently always fails for every user. The fix is to add the same parse_bcrypt_cost guard that crates/auth/src/store.rs has.
